businessContacts.title: Brand business contacts
businessContacts.description: Commercial emails found on the brand website or search snippets with literal evidence. Separate from person leads.

bbc.activeBanner: Contact Discovery (2A + 2B): brand inboxes and LinkedIn people via Mastra + Bright Data. Literal emails only — never invented.
bbc.processingBody: The AI research job is running (brand pages ± SERP). This is not an error.
bbc.partialProcessingTitle: Search in progress — contacts already visible
bbc.partialProcessingBody: {count} business contact(s) exist for this brand while the run is still PROCESSING. They may be partial or orphaned (no runId link).
bbc.resultsFoundPartial: Some pages failed; results may be partial.
bbc.noMatchesTitle: No literal emails on the website
bbc.noMatchesBody: The system responded successfully. It opened brand pages and found no emails written in the HTML (many brands only offer a form).
bbc.providerFailureBody: Bright Data did not return reliable content ({kind}). This is not the same as “no matches”.
bbc.failedBody: The run failed in the application or while persisting status.
bbc.failedOrphansNote: Business contacts exist for this brand; the model does not link them to this run (no runId).
